title: Blazing Spring Orchid
author: Jiang Mo Tian
synopsis:
The entire capital was waiting to see her humiliated, and so was Xie Yihe.

Jiang Yutang did not argue or make a scene. Instead, she quietly planned their divorce.

Reborn in this life, she would choose anyone but Xie Yihe.

Her obedience unsettled him, her indifference frustrated him. Until she, adorned in glory, sought only a divorce decree; then Xie Yihe finally panicked.

He desperately used every means to stop her from leaving, even abandoning his first love!

Later, someone loved Jiang Yutang with all his life, treating her like a treasure, his heart and eyes filled only with her.

As Xie Yihe gradually awoke his past-life memories, his eyes reddened, not daring to take a single step closer.

Fearful that even this last chance to see her from afar would vanish...

chapters.title: Husband’s First Love
chapters.content:
Her husband’s first love had returned.

In the capital during the third month, the chill of early spring had not yet faded.

Jiang Yutang sat inside the carriage, silently watching her husband, Xie Yihe, and his first love from a distance.

In the hunting ground, Xie Yihe’s usually cold face showed an affectionate expression Jiang Yutang had never seen before.

He stepped forward, gently pulling the petite figure into his arms, lowering his head to whisper something softly, making the woman’s cheeks flush pink.

Then, Xie Yihe began teaching her archery, their movements extremely intimate.

“Tch, what kind of cousin is she? This servant thinks she’s just a vixen here to seduce the young master!” Chun Tao, the maid inside the carriage, said indignantly.

The day before, Xie Yihe had brought the woman into the estate under the pretense of being a distant cousin. Surprisingly, no one in the Duke’s mansion had raised any objections.

Jiang Yutang watched the two of them from afar, suddenly feeling a deep sense of futility. She lowered the carriage curtain.

That woman was not some distant cousin of Xie Yihe’s; she was his long-lost first love.

It was this very woman who, a year later, had caused Xie Yihe to sever ties with her maternal family, the Jiang clan, at all costs to divorce Jiang Yutang, reducing her to the laughingstock of the entire capital and casting her into ruin.

Jiang Yutang had never expected that the first thing she would do after reincarnating would be to investigate this woman’s whereabouts and secretly follow her here.

She was desperate to know: where exactly had she, the legitimate daughter of the Zhenyuan Marquis, fallen short?

In the past, Jiang Yutang hadn’t understood. But now, it was as if she suddenly did.

Xie Yihe’s heart…

Had never belonged to her from the beginning!

A wife not loved was nothing but an empty title!

“Young Madam, should this servant take some people to cause a scene, tear that vixen apart, and ruin her reputation?” Chun Tao hesitated, then continued, “If you’re worried about the Young Master’s face, this servant can find a hard-to-detect poison and secretly put it in that vixen’s food, silently finishing her off?”

In her past life, upon hearing such a suggestion, Jiang Yutang would have accepted without hesitation.

Back then, she had loved Xie Yihe with all her heart, stubbornly trying to hold onto him, no matter the cost; even her life. But she hadn’t expected to end up with a reputation for being vicious and jealous, ultimately spurned by all, her family destroyed, and dying a terrible death.

It was both ridiculous and tragic.

Now, none of that had happened yet. There was still time to change everything.

Jiang Yutang slowly opened her closed eyes, her gaze filled only with calm detachment.

“No need. Let’s go back.”

In her past life, every time she had tried to harm Yun Qianqian, she and Chun Tao had ended up suffering instead. Later, Jiang Yutang learned that this was Xie Yihe’s way of protecting his first love.

Chun Tao was stunned, her heart aching as she said, “But Young Madam, today is your birthday. The Young Master said he would accompany you after court…”

Moreover, when Xie Yihe’s life had hung by a thread, it was their Young Madam who had traveled a thousand miles, bowing at every step, kneeling three thousand times to beg for a miraculous cure, pulling him back from the brink of death.

It was also their Young Madam who, despite the backlash, had defied her family’s objections and resolutely married him.

Now, the Jiang family had been exiled to the frontier. In this capital, Jiang Yutang had no one but her husband, Xie Yihe.

If even her birthday meant nothing to Xie Yihe, then truly, no one would care.

Jiang Yutang no longer cared about such things. She said indifferently, “It’s just a birthday. Without him, I can still celebrate it myself.”

Since she had hit rock bottom, it was time to cut her losses.

Chun Tao’s eyes were filled with shock.

The carriage slowly made its way back to the Duke’s mansion.

Upon returning to the Dream Garden, Jiang Yutang began to take stock of her dowry.

Chun Tao had prepared longevity noodles for her, carrying them into the main room and placing them on the table.

The noodles were garnished with green onion, steaming hot, and fragrant.

“Young Madam, this servant made them personally for you. Eat them while they’re hot. You must finish the whole bowl without biting the noodles!”

Before she could finish speaking, a steady, powerful footsteps could be heard from outside.

Jiang Yutang was taken aback and looked toward the sound.

The next moment, a tall figure lifted the curtain and entered; it was Xie Yihe!

He wore a dark robe, his face as handsome as a celestial being, with a pair of beautiful peach-blossom eyes. When he focused on someone, it always made them feel as if they, too, were deeply loved by him.

Xie Yihe entered the main room and saw the longevity noodles on the round table. His brows furrowed sharply.

“There’s no need for such a pretentious reminder. I remember today is your birthday. I’ve already had someone prepare a gift for you.”

What?

Before Jiang Yutang could respond, he continued, “I’ll go bathe first.”

With that, he strode toward the side room.

Chun Tao’s eyes widened in shock. She looked back at Jiang Yutang, who was still seated, staring blankly at the bowl of longevity noodles in front of her.

Chun Tao felt a pang of heartache.

“Young Madam, the Young Master…”

“Take it away.”

Jiang Yutang suddenly lost her appetite.

If a man’s heart was elsewhere, then everything she did would be wrong.

Chun Tao had no choice but to comply.

After about the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, Xie Yihe emerged from the side room. By then, only Jiang Yutang remained in the main room.

The candlelight was bright. The woman slowly moved to the desk, seemingly reviewing something.

“Why are you still sitting out here?”

Xie Yihe walked behind Jiang Yutang. His unique sandalwood fragrance enveloped her as he lightly embraced her from behind.

Jiang Yutang’s body stiffened instantly.

“I said I would spend today with you, and I won’t go back on my word.” Xie Yihe spoke in a tone that sounded almost like charity.

He lowered his head, gazing at Jiang Yutang’s beautiful profile. A hint of desire colored his eyes as he reached out to pinch her chin, examining her closely. “Another year older. Let me see if you’ve become more sensible.”

Xie Yihe’s so-called affection was nothing more than teasing, no different from playing with an obedient kitten or puppy.

His other hand began to move restlessly, his long fingers slipping beneath her collar.

But before he could touch her smooth skin, Jiang Yutang suddenly grabbed his hand tightly!

Xie Yihe was startled. He saw Jiang Yutang turn her head, her watery eyes filled with cold indifference, completely devoid of the usual shyness and affection.

“Let’s divorce.”

Jiang Yutang spoke, her voice clear like pearls dropping onto jade.

Xie Yihe was instantly stunned, even doubting if he had heard correctly.

“What did you say?”

Jiang Yutang patiently repeated herself.

“Xie Yihe, I said, let’s divorce.”

---

chapters.title: Let’s Divorce
chapters.content:
In her past life, when Xie Yihe had proposed divorce, she had refused, clinging on by any means necessary.

In this life, Jiang Yutang decided to set herself free.

Their eyes met. Xie Yihe’s narrow eyes gradually turned cold.

“Yutang, you’re being ridiculous.”

He released Jiang Yutang’s hand, straightened up, and said coldly, “I know you went to the hunting ground today and are upset, but playing such tricks won’t threaten me. Qianqian is very important to me. I won’t drive her away for you.”

Yun Qianqian was Xie Yihe’s beloved first love.

“Don’t worry, I know my place.”

Jiang Yutang gave a self-deprecating smile before continuing, “It’s been three years. I’m tired. Since you don’t love me, why not end it here?”

Xie Yihe’s face was filled with sarcasm. He didn’t believe Jiang Yutang would actually agree to a divorce.

Suddenly, his gaze fell on the documents on the table…

They were Jiang Yutang’s inventory of her dowry!

Xie Yihe was taken aback. Looking at Jiang Yutang’s determined expression, he realized; she was serious!

Jiang Yutang truly didn’t want to be with him anymore!

A surge of unnamed anger flared in Xie Yihe’s heart. “Yutang, are you toying with me?”

He stared directly into Jiang Yutang’s eyes, kindly reminding her, “Don’t forget, the position of Young Master’s wife; you begged for it, crying and making a scene. Now you regret it so soon? Already tired of the title?”

Xie Yihe was the heir of the Duke of An, the current Grand General.

Three years ago, when Jiang Yutang heard that Xie Yihe was considering marriage, she had gone to extreme lengths to marry him, even staging a suicide attempt at home.

At that time, the Jiang family had held leverage over the Xie family. Jiang Yutang’s parents, the Marquis of Zhenyuan and his wife, had no choice but to use this to force Xie Yihe into marriage.

This was a great humiliation for Xie Yihe.

But as the future Duke of An, he had to consider the entire family’s reputation. At the time, though he had no one in his heart, he still needed a noble wife to uphold the family’s image. So, he had settled for Jiang Yutang for three years.

“There’s no such easy thing in this world, my Young Master’s wife.”

Xie Yihe’s narrow eyes were filled with mockery as he analyzed the situation.

“Moreover, Yutang, you’re no longer young. Don’t be so naive…”

He continued, “Not to mention your lack of passion in bed; you don’t even know how to please a man. And with your parents far away in the frontier, you have no one in the capital. Do you really think you can live well alone after leaving me and this Duke’s mansion?”

Jiang Yutang’s numb heart felt a sharp sting, as if pricked by a needle.

Her parents, the Marquis of Zhenyuan and his wife, had lived honest lives, but because they had threatened the Xie family for their daughter’s sake, they had acted against their conscience, leaving a stain on their reputation.

From then on, they had been thoroughly disheartened with their unfilial daughter. After giving her a generous dowry, they had taken her brother and sister to the frontier to atone, cutting off all contact with her.

This was a wound in Jiang Yutang’s heart that had never healed, and Xie Yihe clearly knew this.

But what she hadn’t expected was that one day, Xie Yihe would be the one to tear open this wound himself!

Jiang Yutang’s emotions wavered slightly. She suppressed them with great effort, but a trace of sorrow still seeped into her voice. “After the divorce, I have my own plans. I won’t trouble Lord Xie to worry about me!”

Xie Yihe hadn’t expected that, even after he had said all this, Jiang Yutang would still insist.

What was more crucial…

“What did you call me?”

Xie Yihe couldn’t believe it. His expression turned ugly as he asked in disbelief.

Ever since they had married, even during arguments, Jiang Yutang had always addressed him as “husband,” no matter how upset she was. This was the first time she had addressed him so distantly.

In the past, Jiang Yutang had always been gentle and obedient in front of him… at least on the surface.

Her sudden rebellion stirred a wave of irritation in Xie Yihe’s heart.

The two stood facing each other across the table. Jiang Yutang looked directly into Xie Yihe’s eyes and enunciated each word clearly: “Lord Xie!”

“Very well.”

Xie Yihe’s knuckles tightened, his expression darkening, making it impossible to read his emotions.

The room fell into a deathly silence, so quiet it was unsettling.

After a long while, Xie Yihe let out a cold laugh. “Yutang, from the moment you married me, you should have known there would be no love between us.”

He looked down at Jiang Yutang with a haughty gaze, his voice chillingly indifferent. “I will never agree to a divorce, and I have no interest in arguing meaningless things with you. Calm down and think it over.”

With that, Xie Yihe turned and left the Dream Garden without a backward glance.

Behind the desk, Jiang Yutang’s expression was unsightly.

She came from a military family. Though she was a woman, she had trained in martial arts with her grandfather since childhood. At ten, her father had sent her to Meishan to study. Later, to marry Xie Yihe, she had spent time learning the three obediences and four virtues, women’s virtues, and household management.

How could Xie Yihe assume that she would live miserably without him?

Her dowry alone was enough to ensure she lived comfortably for the rest of her life. She didn’t need to continue suffering in the Duke’s mansion.

She was determined to divorce Xie Yihe!

---

The next day, after getting up and washing, Jiang Yutang went to her mother-in-law, Madam Xie’s courtyard.

The Duke of An’s family was a hereditary noble family in the capital. As a prominent century-old clan, they placed great importance on rules. Morning and evening greetings were mandatory.

Jiang Yutang was still the Duke’s daughter-in-law, and her mother-in-law, the Duchess of An, had never liked her. If she didn’t go, she would surely be made difficult.

When she entered the room, Madam Xie was already seated in front of her dressing table, having her hair styled by a maid.

“Daughter-in-law greets Mother.” Jiang Yutang performed a proper curtsy.

Madam Xie didn’t even glance at her, not sparing so much as a sideways look.

All the women in the room looked over. They knew Madam Xie was displeased because Xie Yihe had left the Dream Garden in anger the previous night and slept in the study. She was intentionally asserting her authority over her daughter-in-law.

Next, there would be a scene for Jiang Yutang to endure!

The women exchanged glances, all ready to watch the drama unfold.

The elegant room was so quiet that the sound of a needle dropping could be heard.

Jiang Yutang bent down to greet Madam Xie but received no response, left awkwardly maintaining her bowing posture.

Her eyes darkened slightly as she slowly straightened up.

Sure enough, the next moment, Liu Mama, who stood beside Madam Xie, immediately stepped forward and publicly reprimanded her. “The Madam hasn’t excused you yet. How dare you stand up on your own? Do you not know the rules, or are you deliberately trying to embarrass the Madam because you think she’s kind?”

Liu Mama was highly favored by Madam Xie. She was usually very arrogant and difficult to get along with, often bullying Jiang Yutang openly or secretly.

In her past life, there had been countless times when she had been publicly scolded like this, humiliated under the guise of teaching manners.

Jiang Yutang had always wanted to please her mother-in-law, so every time, she had endured it like a grandchild, not daring to lift her head, bearing the humiliation.

“Is this the upbringing of your Jiang family?”

Liu Mama frowned, looking at Jiang Yutang with disdain. “No wonder you dare to disrespect the Young Master. If this gets out, it will be a disgrace!”

Madam Xie did not stop her.

The gazes of the crowd, some schadenfreude, some sympathetic, all fell on Jiang Yutang, who stood in the center.

They all expected Jiang Yutang to embarrassedly admit her mistake, but to their surprise…

Jiang Yutang looked up at Liu Mama and asked, “What did you say?”

Liu Mama sneered. “Even if Young Madam is unhappy, this old servant must say it. Everyone in our Duke’s mansion is a person of status. If you lack proper etiquette, it’s fine if you embarrass yourself, but don’t drag the Duke’s mansion down with you!”

Jiang Yutang looked sincerely eager to learn. “Oh, then could Liu Mama come over and instruct me on proper etiquette?”

Liu Mama was only too happy to oblige.

She picked up the ruler, walking over without hesitation. Just as she was about to speak…

SLAP!

Jiang Yutang suddenly slapped her across the face.

chapters.title: A Resounding Slap
chapters.content:
The slap was swift and fierce, delivered with all of Jiang Yutang’s strength.

Liu Mama’s neat bun was knocked askew, her eyes wide with disbelief. Her cheek swelled rapidly, and the corner of her mouth split open.

Everyone in the room was stunned. Even the servants waiting by the door never expected the usually graceful and gentle young mistress to suddenly strike out!

"Young Mistress, I was only doing this for your own good! What are you doing?"

Liu Mama clutched her face, nearly driven mad with rage.

She had intended to vent on behalf of Madam Xie and assert dominance over the concubines and their daughters. She never expected to be scolded by Jiang Yutang instead.

"A mere servant dares to act wild and ride roughshod over her masters. Have you had it too good for too long that you’ve forgotten your place?"

Jiang Yutang’s eyes were icy as she continued, "My mother-in-law hasn’t even spoken, yet you presume to act on her behalf. You take a trivial matter and deliberately pick a fight with me, going on and on about 'our Duke’s mansion.' Are you a servant of the Duke’s mansion, or its ancestor?"

Jiang Yutang’s sharp words left Liu Mama speechless, her face flushed as she shot a pleading glance at Madam Xie.

"Madam, I’ve been wronged..."

Madam Xie’s expression was far from pleasant.

Jiang Yutang’s slap had not only struck Liu Mama’s face but also her own dignity!

Yet, her earlier words had put her in a difficult position. If she made an issue of this, she would only confirm the accusation of mistreating her daughter-in-law.

Madam Xie reassessed Jiang Yutang. She had no idea her usually submissive eldest daughter-in-law had such a fierce side!

"Liu Mama, who gave you permission to act on my behalf? I have no need for your service here. Get out, and don’t block my view."

Though Madam Xie’s words were a reprimand, her tone was light, and she let the matter drop.

Liu Mama, still clutching her face, responded awkwardly. She shot Jiang Yutang a triumphant glance before retreating from the main room.

"You, too; what’s the point in arguing with a servant? And to strike her yourself! Where is the dignity of a matriarch from a noble family?" Madam Xie sat at her vanity, frowning in displeasure as she chastised Jiang Yutang.

Then, turning to the maid combing her hair, she said, "Since A Tang is here, I won’t need your service anymore."

This was clearly a signal for Jiang Yutang to attend to her.

Jiang Yutang had no choice but to step forward and take the comb from the maid’s hands.

In this life and the last, she had often helped Madam Xie with her toilette. Skilled, she deftly styled her hair into a bun.

"You still serve me best." Madam Xie looked at her reflection in the bronze mirror, her expression softening as she praised Jiang Yutang.

Then she added, "A Tang, among all my daughters-in-law and nieces, you are the one I cherish the most. That’s why, even when you throw little tantrums and keep Xie Yihe all to yourself, I’ve never interfered or said much."

Jiang Yutang lowered her gaze, her hands never stopping.

She knew full well that Xie Yihe didn’t love her. How could she possibly monopolize him?

Xie Yihe was an ambitious man, his mind consumed by court affairs, leaving no room for personal sentiments. That was why, for now, Jiang Yutang was the only one in his household.

Madam Xie had suggested multiple times that Xie Yihe take concubines, but he had rejected each proposal. It wasn’t that Madam Xie didn’t want to interfere; it was that she couldn’t sway Xie Yihe.

Jiang Yutang understood Madam Xie’s implication; she was once again urging her to bear a grandson.

Long ago, Jiang Yutang had once yearned for a child of her own with Xie Yihe.

But Xie Yihe had absolutely forbidden it!

Perhaps, in his heart, he believed she, Jiang Yutang, was unworthy of bearing his children!

That was why, after every intimate encounter, he would send someone to ensure she drank the contraceptive decoction. Such private matters were impossible to discuss openly.

Madam Xie, desperate for a grandson, had relentlessly pressured Jiang Yutang. Over three years, she had forced countless tonics and medicines upon her.

"But A Tang, it’s been three years. What’s wrong with your belly? Why is there still no sign of life?"

Madam Xie turned her head slightly, her voice tinged with anger, but she forgot that Jiang Yutang was still adjusting her earrings. The sudden movement yanked her ear, causing a sharp pain.

"Ouch... How could you be so careless!"

"Eldest Sister-in-law, look at you; you’ve hurt Mother! How clumsy can you be? Let me do it instead!" Xie Chaoyu burst into the room in a flurry.

Madam Xie had two sons and one daughter. Xie Chaoyu was her youngest daughter and Xie Yihe’s own sister.

By now, Jiang Yutang had finished styling Madam Xie’s hair, leaving only the final step of putting on the earrings.

Xie Chaoyu quickly stepped forward, paying no heed to Jiang Yutang’s consent. She snatched the earrings from her hands and shoved Jiang Yutang aside.

"Mother, my hands are gentle. I promise I won’t hurt you like Eldest Sister-in-law did."

As she spoke, Xie Chaoyu deftly fastened the earrings for Madam Xie. Then, feigning surprise, she looked at the bronze mirror and said, "Oh! Is this still my mother? After my touch, you look years younger. If I said you were a young maiden, people would believe me!"

Xie Chaoyu’s smooth talk coaxed a delighted smile from Madam Xie.

"You always know how to make me happy."

Mother and daughter chatted merrily, their joy palpable, while Jiang Yutang was completely sidelined.

The other women in the room were long accustomed to this. In Madam’s chambers, it was always Jiang Yutang who toiled endlessly, yet in the end, it was Xie Chaoyu who reaped the rewards and won Madam Xie’s favor.

"Oh, I also brought something good for Eldest Sister-in-law."

Xie Chaoyu’s eyes gleamed mischievously as she shot Jiang Yutang a sidelong glance. Then, with an air of mystery, she pulled out a yellow talisman.

"Mother, aren’t you always worried about Eldest Brother’s lack of heirs? Early this morning, I specially went to Hanshan Temple and sincerely asked the master for this child-bearing talisman. The master said that if we burn it to ashes and have Eldest Sister-in-law drink it with water, she’ll have good news within a month. Then you can look forward to holding a chubby grandson!"

Madam Xie saw through her daughter’s little scheme, but since Xie Chaoyu had put her in such a good mood, she pretended to scold, lightly tapping Xie Chaoyu’s forehead.

"Young lady, you never take anything seriously! But it’s rare for you to show such thoughtfulness. A Tang, burn this talisman and drink it."

"I’ll do it, I’ll do it!"

Xie Chaoyu was unusually eager. She took the fire folder, lit the talisman, and mixed the ashes into a cup of dark, murky water.

With a broad smile, she picked up the cup from the table and walked over to Jiang Yutang.

"Eldest Sister-in-law, you’ve always drunk the medicines Mother prescribed for you. Don’t refuse my good intentions. Drink this talisman water, and you’ll surely give Eldest Brother a big, fat son. Then, those people in the capital won’t dare call you a barren hen anymore."

Xie Chaoyu seemed to have Jiang Yutang’s best interests at heart.

But…

She had secretly added something to the talisman water.

In her past life, Jiang Yutang had been forced to drink it, suffering from severe abdominal pain for two whole days, becoming the laughingstock of the entire Duke’s mansion. After that, Xie Chaoyu had tormented her even more, mocking her without restraint.

Reborn, Jiang Yutang knew all too well that endless concession would not bring peace; it would only make the other party more audacious.

Her eyes turned icy. "I don’t want to drink it."

Xie Chaoyu’s smile vanished instantly. "Eldest Sister-in-law, don’t be so selfish! You’re the one who can’t bear children, preventing Mother from holding a grandson. I’m trying to help you, and this is how you repay me? Are you deliberately trying to cut off Eldest Brother’s lineage?"

"How dare I?"

Jiang Yutang gave a faint smile. "The physician has examined me; there’s nothing wrong with my body. If you’re truly in such a hurry, why not give the talisman water to your Eldest Brother instead?"

"How could Eldest Brother drink this?"

Xie Chaoyu’s eyes widened in fury.

The moment the words left her mouth, she realized her mistake. She quickly shifted the blame. "Oh, so now you’re not only ungrateful to Mother’s wish for a grandson, but you’re also implying there’s something wrong with Eldest Brother?"

If Jiang Yutang claimed her own body was fine, then the implication was that the problem lay with Xie Yihe.

Just then, Xie Yihe, who had been resting at home that day, reached the doorway. He heard these words and abruptly stopped, standing frozen in the corridor.

---

chapters.title: Imperial Decree for Divorce
chapters.content:
Jiang Yutang remained composed. "Those weren’t my words."

Xie Chaoyu was at a loss for words, her expression turning ugly.

"My brother’s childhood friends all have children running around, yet because of you, my brother still has no heirs."

Madam Xie also furrowed her brows. "A Tang, Chaoyu is only trying to help. How can you be so ungrateful? As someone married into the Duke’s mansion, you should prioritize the Xie family’s descendants. Otherwise, outsiders will think you’re both jealous and useless!"

"I can’t control what others say."

Jiang Yutang’s eyes were filled with indifference. "If that’s what you think, Madam, then today we should arrange for the Young Master to take several concubines, so they can quickly bear children for the Xie family."

Times had changed.

Even if a hundred concubines were brought into Xie Yihe’s quarters now, it wouldn’t matter to her.

This way, everyone in the mansion would see clearly: if there was only Jiang Yutang in Xie Yihe’s household, was it because she was jealous and blocking others, or because Madam Xie herself wouldn’t allow it?

Madam Xie was left speechless.

"If there’s nothing else, Mother, your daughter-in-law will take her leave."

With that, Jiang Yutang turned and left the room with calm composure, stunning everyone present.

But just as she stepped outside, she collided with Xie Yihe.

She showed no expression, brushing past him without so much as a greeting, and left the courtyard with Chun Tao.

Xie Yihe’s face darkened instantly.

From inside the room, Madam Xie’s angry voice rang out, "She’s gone too far! This is getting ridiculous! We were only trying to do her a favor by having her drink the talisman water. We didn’t wrong her, yet she’s the one making a scene!"

Before the words had faded, Xie Yihe entered the room. Hearing this, his thick brows knitted tightly together.

"Yihe..."

Madam Xie was taken aback, her face filled with confusion. "Why are you here?"

Xie Chaoyu quickly tattled, "Eldest Brother, you heard what that woman said just now, right? She was so rude to both me and Mother. You must teach her a lesson and avenge us!"

Unexpectedly…

Xie Yihe addressed Madam Xie, "Mother, it is I who have been focused solely on my career and do not wish for children. This has nothing to do with A Tang. In the future, stop giving her those nonsensical things to drink."

Then, turning to Xie Chaoyu, he added, "And you; from now on, speak to your sister-in-law with respect. No more rudeness!"

Madam Xie was stunned.

Xie Yihe had never shown concern for Jiang Yutang before. This was the first time he had spoken up for her.

Xie Chaoyu, unwilling to accept this, was about to retort, but Madam Xie quickly pulled her back, afraid her daughter would provoke Xie Yihe further.

After all, if they were to truly investigate, the fault lay with her daughter.

Madam Xie first inquired about the matter of heirs. Xie Yihe gave a few perfunctory responses before excusing himself and leaving.

Though he didn’t love Jiang Yutang and resented the forced marriage, he had no immediate plans to replace his wife.

Moreover, Jiang Yutang was beautiful and graceful; at least in marital matters, Xie Yihe was quite satisfied.

For this reason, he was willing to make this small concession.

He also hoped Jiang Yutang would know when to stop.

The news of Xie Yihe defending Jiang Yutang spread like wildfire through the mansion. By the time it reached Dream Garden, Xie Yihe had finally seen Jiang Yutang.

Inside the main house of Dream Garden, Jiang Yutang sat on a soft couch, holding a book, her expression distant.

Seeing this, Xie Yihe spoke first.

"I’ve explained the matter of the child to Mother and scolded Chaoyu. Such things won’t happen again. If you have any other requests, you can tell me directly."

Jiang Yutang listened quietly.

She had known Xie Yihe for many years and understood his nature. He never involved himself in household affairs, let alone those concerning her. It was unprecedented for him to step in on her behalf.

By all rights...

She should be grateful and accept his offer to avoid wasting his goodwill.

Xie Yihe stood above her, looking down, and continued, "However, the contraceptive decoction won’t stop. You’ll still have to drink it as usual."

"What if I do get pregnant?"

Jiang Yutang suddenly wanted to ask.

Xie Yihe lifted his thin eyelids slightly, responding with casual indifference, "Then abort it."

Jiang Yutang’s lips twisted in a self-mocking smile.

She was fortunate she hadn’t been foolish enough to secretly replace the contraceptive decoction. Otherwise, that would have truly harmed both herself and others.

Xie Yihe had just spoken softly, but in his concessions...

He hadn’t mentioned Yun Qianqian at all. That meant if she accepted, nothing would change in the future.

And she would remain trapped in this hopeless, suffocating marital prison.

Jiang Yutang was truly exhausted.

"I..."

"Young Master!"

Just as Jiang Yutang was about to have a heart-to-heart with Xie Yihe,she wasn’t trying to pick a fight with him,someone suddenly entered from outside, interrupting her. It was Chu Ge, Xie Yihe’s close bodyguard.

Chu Ge entered and bowed respectfully to Xie Yihe. His gaze toward Jiang Yutang was cold, devoid of any respect.

"What is it?" Xie Yihe turned to ask.

Chu Ge didn’t avoid Jiang Yutang, the legitimate wife, and bluntly said, "Miss Yun asks if you’re still coming to her place for lunch?"

Xie Yihe’s brows furrowed. "She hasn’t eaten yet?"

"She’s been waiting for you." Chu Ge lowered his head and replied.

"Nonsense."

Xie Yihe didn’t spare Jiang Yutang another glance.

Without a moment’s hesitation, he left her behind and strode out of the main house to seek another woman.

Chu Ge shot Jiang Yutang a scornful look before following, their tall figures disappearing from Dream Garden.

Chun Tao stood at the door, her heart aching with anger.

"The Young Master rarely takes the initiative to reconcile with you, and you two hadn’t even exchanged a few words before that vixen couldn’t wait to come and snatch him away. And that guard Chu; really, he’s insufferable!"

She fumed, "Relying on the Young Master’s favor, he’s been looking down on us since the day he entered the mansion. Now with Miss Yun here, he’s truly shown his colors."

Xie Yihe’s indifference toward Jiang Yutang extended to his trusted aides, who also showed her no respect.

The more Chun Tao ranted, the more aggrieved she felt.

The Young Master wouldn’t allow her mistress to have children.

Without descendants to rely on, how would her mistress spend the rest of her life?

Jiang Yutang calmly set down her book and stood up.

"Come, help me change and do my hair."

"Mistress, where are you going?"

Chun Tao paused, confused. "Are you going to see Old Madam to seek justice?"

Old Madame Xie, Xie Yihe’s grandmother, was the only one in the Duke’s mansion who was willing to protect Jiang Yutang.

Jiang Yutang had no desire to compete for Xie Yihe’s affection or do anything undignified.

She saw Xie Yihe’s stance clearly; he didn’t want a divorce and intended to maintain the status quo.

But such a marriage was like a dull knife cutting into her flesh; constant, unending pain.

She didn’t want to witness Xie Yihe fall in love with another woman again.

Nor did she want to continue enduring in silence until Xie Yihe himself proposed a divorce a year later.

Jiang Yutang looked out the window, her eyes reflecting a cold sharpness.

"I’m going to the palace to ask His Majesty to grant me a divorce."

chapters.title: She Will No Longer Serve Him
chapters.content:
Chun Tao was stunned by these words.

Earlier, Jiang Yutang had proposed a divorce by mutual consent...

She had always believed that Jiang Yutang was dissatisfied with Yun Qianqian and wanted to scare Xie Yihe.

"Young Madam, you... don't act impulsively. Have you thought this through? Once you enter the palace and the Emperor makes the decision, there will be no chance to turn back..."

Chun Tao panicked and quickly continued.

"Even if Young Master is fond of Yun Qianqian, you are his lawfully wedded wife. She isn't even a concubine. How can she bypass you? Otherwise, endure a little more. Maybe Young Master will change his mind."

Chun Tao wanted to persuade Jiang Yutang further, but Jiang Yutang's resolve was firmer than ever.

"Silly girl, why do you think everyone in the Duke's mansion dares to treat us this way? Isn't it because they assume I'm completely under Xie Yihe's control and willing to compromise?"

Jiang Yutang turned her head and smiled. "If I don't stand up for myself, even after leaving the Duke's mansion, we can still live well. My mind is made up. Don't try to persuade me, and don't say such discouraging words anymore."

Chun Tao felt lost, unsure if this was right or wrong. Unable to change Jiang Yutang's mind, she could only help her change clothes and comb her hair behind the screen.

In the afternoon, the two left the Duke's mansion and headed straight for the imperial palace.

The sky was overcast with thick, dark clouds, eerily silent.

At the end of the long white jade steps stood the vermilion-lacquered gates of the imperial study, tightly shut. Armed guards stood sternly on either side, the atmosphere severe and solemn.

Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao waited outside for the summons.

The current emperor of Beiming, Bei Ming Jun, had once studied martial arts under her grandfather, making him somewhat of a senior martial brother to her.

Jiang Yutang hoped that Bei Ming Jun would, for the sake of her grandfather and their shared martial arts background, grant her request for a divorce from Xie Yihe.

However…

A full two hours passed, and she hadn't even caught a glimpse of this "senior brother."

Jiang Yutang didn't want to give up just like that.

She wanted to wait a little longer, to fight for an opportunity for herself.

The early spring wind was like an icy blade. Jiang Yutang stood by the pillar beside the imperial study, her exposed skin stinging from the cold, her cheeks flushed red.

She fixed her gaze on the door of the imperial study, standing like a statue, motionless. Her body was numb from the cold, her hands and feet losing sensation.

Chun Tao looked at Jiang Yutang with heartache.

This path... might not work.

Suddenly, with a click, the heavy door was pushed open. The eunuch Chang Shun walked out from the imperial study.

Jiang Yutang's eyelashes trembled as she quickly stepped forward. "Eunuch Chang Shun, has His Majesty agreed to see me?"

"This..."

Chang Shun thought of the Emperor's refusal, his face showing difficulty.

He tactfully said, "Young Madam, your timing today is truly unfortunate. His Majesty is busy at the moment and has no time to see you. The weather is so cold, and you're already frozen. Why not go back first?"

Hearing these words, Jiang Yutang's heart instantly turned cold.

His Majesty didn't want to see her.

Indeed.

Xie Yihe was currently a highly influential figure in the court.

Her grandfather had passed away years ago. The small favor from back then wasn't enough to soften the heart of this young emperor.

In the end, she had been naive.

Chang Shun looked at Jiang Yutang's purple, frozen hands and couldn't bear it. He said to Chun Tao, "Quickly, help your mistress go back."

Chun Tao immediately agreed and supported Jiang Yutang as they turned back.

The palace path was long, stretching beyond sight.

"Young Madam, perhaps we should forget about the divorce..." Chun Tao lowered her voice, nervously suggesting.

The Young Master had never agreed to the divorce in the first place. If he found out that Young Madam had been secretly planning this behind his back, she didn't dare imagine what would happen.

Jiang Yutang's expression was extremely ugly.

Yun Qianqian was not a good person. In her previous life, after moving into the Duke's mansion, she had often instigated the Xie family to scheme against her.

If she truly gave up now, they would be devoured completely, leaving nothing behind.

Walking along the red walls and green tiles, Jiang Yutang pondered.

The Emperor refused to see her because her value wasn't high enough. Moreover, this was a private family matter of a court official, so naturally, he wouldn't intervene.

But what if...

She made the Emperor owe her a favor that he couldn't refuse?

At this thought, Jiang Yutang also recalled a major event from her past life that concerned the Emperor's life.

The Emperor had been ambushed by enemy spies and poisoned with a rare toxin. The entire Imperial Physician's Office was helpless, and his life hung by a thread. It was Xie Yihe who found a famous physician from among the common people, allowing the Emperor to barely survive.

Although the Emperor saved his life, the lingering poison was hard to eliminate. From then on, he was frequently ill and bedridden.

Jiang Yutang calculated the days in her mind. At this point in time...

The Emperor had already been ambushed by the enemy spies.

The hidden poison in his body would flare up in the traveling palace in seven days.

If she seized this opportunity to save the Emperor, not only would the divorce from Xie Yihe be guaranteed, but everything else would become easier in the future.

Jiang Yutang had been mischievous as a child and was sent to Meishan to study. She had learned medicine there. Her master had exquisite medical skills and could perform miraculous cures. She had studied under him for several years and might be able to try.

Jiang Yutang's eyes darkened. After returning to the Dream Garden in the Duke's mansion, she ordered Chun Tao to send someone to inquire whether the Imperial Physician's Office had been recruiting medical women recently.

Although she had studied, she had been confined to the inner quarters for years without the opportunity to practice. Now, she urgently needed a convincing identity.

This matter gave Jiang Yutang an idea. She wanted to use all the useful information from her past life for her own benefit.

Jiang Yutang sat at the desk, focusing on recalling.

Then, she ordered, "Also, give the managers of my shops that are struggling three thousand taels of silver and have them buy merchant ships."

In the future, Beiming's maritime trade would flourish. Investing early would surely bring great profits.

She also needed to plan for her life after the divorce.

Chun Tao was stunned by these orders.

"Yes, this servant will go now."

In the room, Jiang Yutang sat alone at the desk, busy with her tasks.

For a moment, there was silence.

Twilight fell, and night arrived.

Xie Yihe came to Dream Garden.

After marrying Jiang Yutang, except when they quarreled, he usually slept with her.

Jiang Yutang was also willing to serve him.

Although she was somewhat reserved in bed, she tried her best to cooperate and satisfy his excessive demands.

Now that they had made up, there was no need for Xie Yihe to sleep in the study and endure discomfort.

But this time…

The spacious main house was empty of Jiang Yutang. Only a maid with ulterior motives remained, and she had been arranged by Jiang Yutang!

"Young Master, Young Madam said that she isn't feeling well and is afraid of catching a cold and infecting you. So she went to rest in the next room. She especially ordered this servant to attend to you well..."

The maid, with a rosy face, shyly approached and began to untie Xie Yihe's belt.

"It's late. Let this servant help you to bed."

Just as the maid's hand was about to touch Xie Yihe's clothes, he suddenly spoke.

"Get out."

His voice was like icy water from a deep pool, bone-chillingly cold.

The maid's hand froze in mid-air, extremely awkward. She said with a forced smile, "Young Master, if this servant leaves like this, Young Madam might be unhappy..."

In reality, whether Young Madam was happy or not was secondary. The most important thing was that Xie Yihe's mother would be unhappy.

This maid had been arranged by Madam Xie.

Madam Xie was greatly angered by Jiang Yutang's previous actions. Since Jiang Yutang didn't mind Xie Yihe taking concubines, Madam Xie thought she didn't need to be polite either and directly sent people to Xie Yihe's room under Jiang Yutang's name.

Xie Yihe's patience had already run out. He coldly glared at the maid, his voice deep. "Don't make me say it a second time."

This glance was like a cold beam, making the maid's heart tremble. A chilling coldness suddenly rose from her feet and spread throughout her body.

She didn't dare to stay any longer. Lowering her head, she obediently retreated from the main house.

The candlelight in the glass lantern flickered gently.

Xie Yihe entered the inner room. The room was empty. He sat alone on the cold bed, his handsome face indistinct in the dim light.

The night passed quietly and silently.

Jiang Yutang had many daily necessities that she hadn't had time to move to her new residence. The next morning, after getting up, she went to the main house to freshen up.

She didn't want to meet Xie Yihe and knew that he had a habit of practicing martial arts every morning. So she carefully calculated the time and went with Chun Tao.

Jiang Yutang stepped onto the steps and lifted the curtain to enter the main house, only to unexpectedly meet a pair of cold, narrow eyes.

It was Xie Yihe.

He was quietly sitting at the round table, not avoiding her as she had expected.

Morning light filled the room. The servants all kept their heads down, carefully and cautiously going about their tasks. The atmosphere in the room was like a stagnant pool, heavy and frozen.

"Morning."

Jiang Yutang pondered for a moment before taking the initiative to greet him. She asked softly, "Have you finished practicing martial arts?"

She thought that if Xie Yihe's practice time had changed, she would come earlier next time.

Xie Yihe still didn't respond.

His gaze was cold, as if Jiang Yutang was just a complete stranger.

Jiang Yutang had long grown accustomed to this. Her heart didn't ripple at all due to his coldness. Nor did she, as in the past, force herself to endure the inner sadness, put on a warm smile, and deliberately fawn over him or pester him.

She directly walked past Xie Yihe towards the dressing table.

Unexpectedly, just as she brushed past him, he suddenly spoke.

"Are you not tired of playing these tricks every day?"

Jiang Yutang heard this and suddenly stopped, looking at Xie Yihe with confusion.

"I decide for myself who I want to take. It's not your place to interfere."

Xie Yihe stood up, his tall and towering figure looking down at her. His brows were filled with impatience as he coldly said, "You are the Young Madam, not a madam running a brothel. Don't, just to satisfy your own selfishness, push every kind of woman into my bed to test me. If you're not tired, I find it disgusting."

These words were extremely humiliating, especially in front of the servants, leaving Jiang Yutang no face at all.

The servants in the room secretly glanced over.

Jiang Yutang's fingers tightened as she suddenly understood.

She frowned and asked, "Did someone send a woman to your room?"

Xie Yihe had already decided it was Jiang Yutang and didn't want to talk to her. He directly lifted the curtain and left the main house.

"Is the Young Madam someone you all can stare at? Get out, all of you!"

Chun Tao couldn't bear to see Jiang Yutang humiliated and immediately dismissed the servants who were watching the drama.

Once only the mistress and servant remained, Chun Tao's eyes were full of concern. "Young Madam, are you... are you okay? Don't be sad..."

Xie Yihe's prejudice against Jiang Yutang ran deep. He believed she was so in love that she resorted to any means, even using other women to test his feelings. Naturally, this wasn't anything surprising.

Jiang Yutang's heart was probably filled with knives, yet she felt it was nothing out of the ordinary.

Her expression was calm as she indifferently said, "It's not the first day I've known how he feels about me. There's nothing to be sad about. Let's freshen up first. There's still a lot to do."

Since she had decided to use saving the Emperor to separate from Xie Yihe, she didn't want to drag things out any longer.

She planned to quickly sort out the overall accounts of the Duke's mansion, hand over the management rights she had always valued and taken pride in, and formally separate from Xie Yihe.

"Yes, Young Madam."

Chun Tao agreed.

Madam Xie might have been feeling guilty about last night's events. Today, when Jiang Yutang went to pay her respects, she didn't receive too much difficulty. After a simple breakfast with the family, Jiang Yutang returned to Dream Garden to start sorting out the accounts.

In the side room of Dream Garden, Jiang Yutang had Chun Tao bring over the account books and neatly placed them on the table.

The Duke's mansion was large with many businesses. Initially, Xie Yihe had not agreed to let Jiang Yutang, as a new bride, manage the household. But...

Jiang Yutang didn't want to be looked down upon by Xie Yihe and also wanted to get closer to him.

So, even though she knew Madam Xie's intention in giving up the management rights was not good, she still hardened her head and agreed.

Madam Xie was reluctant to spend from her own savings but also wanted the Duke's mansion to be more glorious than other families in the capital. So she ordered Jiang Yutang to solve this problem.

Jiang Yutang had no choice. To please them and make Xie Yihe see her in a new light, she didn't hesitate to dip into her own funds. She used the monthly income from her dowry's shops and properties to support the large Duke's mansion, allowing them to live a more luxurious life than before.

Jiang Yutang had done this without complaint. After three years, she successfully gained the recognition of everyone in the Duke's mansion.

Everyone could see that she did this to please Xie Yihe.

No one would believe that Jiang Yutang would be willing to give up the last bit of dignity she had as the Young Madam.

The steward came to deliver the accounts. Looking at Jiang Yutang busy with the abacus, he habitually thought she was trying to perform well in managing the household to win Xie Yihe's favor.

After all...

The news of Xie Yihe and Jiang Yutang sleeping separately had spread throughout the mansion. They all thought that some conflict had occurred between the two, to the point that Xie Yihe didn't even want to see her.

Time passed quickly when focused. In the blink of an eye, the sun set, and evening arrived.

"This servant greets Young Madam."

A servant quietly entered the side room.

Jiang Yutang was still busy and didn't look up. "What is it?"

The servant replied, "Young Master said he wants you to brew tea and personally deliver it to his study."

Early on, Jiang Yutang had wanted Xie Yihe to like her. Upon learning that he enjoyed tea, she had put great effort into learning how to brew it well.

After Xie Yihe tasted it, he specified that he wanted to drink the tea she brewed whenever he was home.

Jiang Yutang had been overjoyed.

But later...

She gradually realized that Xie Yihe only liked the tea she brewed, but his attitude towards her remained cold and distant.

Moreover, every time she brewed tea, it was taken by a servant. He never gave her the slightest chance to get close to him.

This time, however, he had actually asked her to deliver it herself.

Jiang Yutang hadn't finished her work and directly refused. "I'm busy."

Why should she waste her time on Xie Yihe again?
