chapters.title: She Had Long Given Up
chapters.content:
Who would have expected that upon hearing her words, the servant’s face crumpled, and with a thud, he knelt to the ground.

"Young Madam, this lowly one is only here to deliver a message. Moreover, Young Master is in a foul mood today. If I return like this, I’ll surely be beaten with a board and suffer fleshly pain. Please, Young Madam, show some mercy and pity this lowly one."

With that, he kowtowed loudly several times, his forehead turning red.

Jiang Yutang raised her head and frowned.

She didn’t want to go, but she didn’t want to make things difficult for a servant either.

Forget it. Just this last time.

Tomorrow, she would find someone to teach them how to make tea, so they wouldn’t bother her with such trivial matters again.

Jiang Yutang agreed. She brewed the Jiangnan Fengtuan Que She Yao tea that Xie Yihe and she had always loved. The faint, bitter aroma filled the air. She filled a full pot and placed it on a wooden tray before setting off.

Xie Yihe’s study was not far from Meng Yuan.

The orange-red sunset spilled over, the flowers and trees neatly trimmed. At the end of the bluestone path lay her destination.

Jiang Yutang arrived and knocked on the door with one hand. Unexpectedly, the door was slightly ajar. The moment her hand touched it, the door swung open on its own, revealing the scene inside the study in full view.

Behind the zitan wood desk, Yun Qianqian was sitting on Xie Yihe’s lap, the two of them intimately close, seemingly...

Embraced in affection!

The air suddenly froze.

Jiang Yutang, holding the tray, stood frozen in shock.

"Ah! Sister Jiang is here..."

Yun Qianqian’s delicate face was flushed red. She exclaimed in surprise and quickly climbed off Xie Yihe’s lap, her gaze at Jiang Yutang filled with embarrassment. "I didn’t mean to..."

Xie Yihe’s long eyebrows knitted together, a sharp glint flashing in his narrow eyes. "Who allowed you to come here?"

Jiang Yutang had not expected that in this life, Xie Yihe and Yun Qianqian’s relationship would develop so quickly, so quickly that it caught her completely off guard.

Before Xie Yihe could finish speaking, Chu Ge arrived in large strides, glaring at Jiang Yutang with displeasure, as if she were the one trying to ruin someone else’s marriage.

"Young Madam, Young Master does not wish to see you. Please leave immediately!"

Xie Yihe raised no objections to this.

He coldly stated, "If there is a next time, you need not manage the household anymore."

Jiang Yutang had already decided she would no longer manage the household.

She did not look at the people inside the study again. She shoved the tray into Chu Ge’s hands and said to him,

"You want me to see, yet you fear I’ll make a scene. Aren’t you contradicting yourself? Instead of scheming against me here, you’d be better off guarding the door for them."

Chu Ge, exposed by her, had an extremely ugly expression. He had only wanted Jiang Yutang to know her place...

Jiang Yutang didn’t care what they thought next. After dropping these words, she turned and left without looking back.

She walked swiftly, and behind her, she faintly heard Yun Qianqian’s soft, coquettish voice comforting someone.

"Brother Yihe, is Sister Jiang angry? Don’t take it out on her..."

...

Jiang Yutang walked all the way back to Meng Yuan. Under the corridor, some servants were chatting.

"I heard that Miss Yun went to the study to find Young Master."

"Miss Yun is so beautiful, speaks so gently, and seems so knowledgeable and refined. Young Master really likes her. It’s possible she might even be elevated to a co-wife in the future... Young Madam!"

"Young Madam, we were just chatting casually..."

The two of them, upon seeing Jiang Yutang approach, were immediately embarrassed.

But to their surprise, Jiang Yutang’s face showed no particular expression. She merely gave a soft "mm" and walked past them up the steps, entering the side room.

Yun Qianqian had gone so far as to enter the study and sit on Young Master’s lap, yet the Young Madam, who had always deeply loved Young Master, had not only not made a scene but hadn’t even shown a hint of anger?

Had the sun risen from the west?

This was truly strange.

...

Jiang Yutang had experienced one lifetime and had personally witnessed Xie Yihe’s loss of composure and obsession with Yun Qianqian. She had long since developed the capacity to endure their affair. The little scene she had just witnessed meant nothing to her.

On the contrary, she knew that Xie Yihe was not in the main house at the moment. She called Chun Tao and urged her to quickly move all her daily belongings from the main house over.

Chun Tao was very efficient and soon had everything arranged.

Jiang Yutang continued to handle the account books in the side room when she noticed Chun Tao leaning against the window, seemingly watching something.

She couldn’t help but ask, "What are you doing?"

Chun Tao turned her head, hesitating as she said, "This servant is watching to see if Young Master will come over... to explain to you what happened in the study..."

But the lights in the main house of Meng Yuan had already been extinguished.

It seemed Young Master had no intention of coming to the side room to explain to Jiang Yutang.

Chun Tao’s heart ached terribly, and she felt an urge to cry.

Clearly, Jiang Yutang was Xie Yihe’s lawful wife, yet that Miss Yun had only been here for two days, and Xie Yihe was already so attentive to her.

What about the three years Young Madam had spent in the Duke’s mansion?

Jiang Yutang didn’t know how to explain to Chun Tao that this was only the beginning. She changed the subject and asked, "How did the inquiries about the Imperial Medical Institute go?"

Chun Tao, hearing this, finally snapped out of her sad emotions.

"This servant has made inquiries. The Imperial Medical Institute has indeed posted notices everywhere and is recruiting medical women. However, I heard the assessments are quite difficult, and..." Chun Tao paused for a moment before carefully adding, "The one in Li Hua Yuan has also signed up."

The person residing in Li Hua Yuan of the Duke’s mansion was Yun Qianqian.

Jiang Yutang knew Yun Qianqian would sign up.

She remained composed. "Let her sign up. I’ll take my exam. We don’t need to pay her any mind."

Yun Qianqian was new here and was currently busy familiarizing herself with the Duke’s mansion and ingratiating herself with everyone. She wouldn’t recklessly act against her for the time being.

Chun Tao, seeing this, said no more.

The next day, Jiang Yutang got up and, as usual, went to Madam Xie’s courtyard. Then, with the large crowd, she arrived at the dining hall, planning to eat breakfast before heading out with Chun Tao to the Imperial Medical Institute.

The women gathered and sat at the octagonal table. Thick brocade cushions were laid on the ground, and maids and servants stood outside.

Madam Xie had Jiang Yutang sit beside her and affectionately took her hands.

She whispered, "A Tang, I was too hasty about the matter of the child. It was also my fault as a mother-in-law for caring improperly. I made you drink all those medicines for no reason. You must not take it to heart or hold a grudge against me."

Jiang Yutang lowered her eyes, hiding the sarcasm within. She knew Madam Xie had more to say.

As expected, Madam Xie shifted the topic.

"Yihe is fine in every other aspect; outstanding in all areas. I don’t need to worry about him. But when it comes to descendants, I don’t know what’s gotten into him. There are some things I, as his mother, can’t say to him. Since you are the one he cherishes, I’m counting on you to enlighten him for me."

Madam Xie wanted her to persuade Xie Yihe to have a child.

Jiang Yutang would have to be mad to go find Xie Yihe and invite humiliation upon herself.

She looked into Madam Xie’s eyes.

"Mother, you should know that Young Master and I have separate rooms, right? Yesterday, he suddenly lost his temper at me for no reason, accusing me of sending someone to him. To this day, I’m still confused. Mother, do you know what that was about?"

chapters.title: Don’t Even Think About Touching My Things
chapters.content:
Madam Xie, of course, knew; because that beautiful maid had been sent by her.

The smile on her lips froze, and she awkwardly let go of Jiang Yutang’s hand.

"But we can’t just let things go on like this, can we?"

Jiang Yutang didn’t take the bait.

She respectfully said, "Mother, please have your meal first. Don’t let this upset you."

Madam Xie was truly displeased now.

Was this Jiang Yutang unable to understand what she was saying?

"Mother, my elder sister-in-law doesn’t even have the right to get pregnant. Last night, she was even chased out of the study by my elder brother. They’ve already separated rooms. Can’t you see how much my elder brother dislikes her? What do you expect her to accomplish?"

Xie Chaoyu, sitting on the other side of Madam Xie, saw her mother being rejected and felt a surge of hidden annoyance. She directly raised her voice in sarcasm, "You might as well save those words for the newly arrived Yun Qianqian."

The other women at the octagonal table didn’t know about what had happened in Xie Yihe’s room. Hearing Xie Chaoyu’s words, they were all somewhat confused.

The second branch’s madam was even more bewildered.

"Third Miss, what are you talking about?"

Xie Chaoyu had been waiting for someone to ask.

With schadenfreude, she looked at Jiang Yutang and publicly tore open her painful wound.

"I only found out these past couple of days that the person my elder brother truly wanted to marry was Yun Qianqian. That’s why he wouldn’t allow my elder sister-in-law to get pregnant and made her drink contraceptive herbs."

With that, everyone at the table turned to look at Jiang Yutang in shock.

No wonder Jiang Yutang had drunk so many medicines over the years without any sign of pregnancy. It turned out Young Master’s heart belonged to someone else, and he didn’t allow her to conceive.

They had all thought Jiang Yutang, as the mistress of the household, had it so good. Who would have thought that in front of her own husband, she wasn’t even as good as a concubine...

This would surely become gossip over tea.

"Young lady, why do you have to blurt out everything?"

Madam Xie pretended to stop her but did not deny Xie Chaoyu’s words.

Xie Chaoyu couldn’t hide her smugness. "Mother, you know I’ve always been straightforward and can’t keep secrets."

This mother and daughter acted in perfect harmony. The second madam felt a pang of discomfort in her heart and deeply regretted asking, which had put Jiang Yutang in such an awkward position.

The second madam looked at Jiang Yutang and consoled her, "A Tang, don’t overthink it. You are Young Master’s lawful wife. He will let you get pregnant sooner or later."

Unfortunately...

No matter how much the second madam tried to restore Jiang Yutang’s dignity, she couldn’t change the facts.

Xie Chaoyu’s words also reminded Madam Xie of Yun Qianqian in Li Hua Yuan.

Xie Yihe didn’t care for Jiang Yutang, but he held Yun Qianqian, who had appeared out of nowhere, in high regard.

She had been received into the Duke’s mansion as a cousin, guarded as if she were a precious treasure. No one was allowed to disturb her, and even her meals were delivered separately.

If Yun Qianqian hadn’t taken the initiative to pay her respects, they might not have seen her face even now.

This was the perfect opportunity for Madam Xie to reprimand Jiang Yutang.

A strange light flickered in her eyes as she deliberately said, "I recall that Qianqian seems to like osmanthus cake. Have this plate sent to her."

Chun Tao, who had been waiting outside, changed color upon hearing this.

She quickly entered and reminded them, "Madam, this osmanthus cake was specially ordered by our Young Madam yesterday because she wanted to eat it."

"Ah, is this A Tang’s?"

Madam Xie feigned surprise and turned to ask with a smile, "A Tang is usually so considerate. Surely she won’t mind this small plate of cakes, will she?"

Chun Tao’s eyebrows tightened.

She wanted to say more, but Jiang Yutang stopped her with a glance.

Jiang Yutang put down her chopsticks and asked slowly, "Mother, do you like Yun Qianqian very much?"

"I am quite fond of her."

Seeing that Jiang Yutang had taken the bait, Madam Xie praised her endlessly.

"That girl Qianqian is clever and quick-witted, intelligent, and catches on to everything quickly. Although she is only a distant relative, Yihe is very fond of her. Who knows, one day she might be brought into the family and become your sister."

"Yun Qianqian is the one my elder brother likes. She is indeed more pleasing to the eye than some people who don’t know how to appreciate kindness..."

Xie Chaoyu thought for a moment and added, "In the future, when she enters the family, she and my elder brother will be of one heart. With my elder sister-in-law managing the household and serving you, Mother, our Duke’s mansion will truly be harmonious and happy."

So, when they were of one heart, did that mean Jiang Yutang was doomed to be a beast of burden?

Even the second madam couldn’t bear to listen any longer.

But her husband was of low birth and held a low-ranking official position. She had little influence and couldn’t speak up for Jiang Yutang.

Faced with these remarks, Jiang Yutang remained composed.

She nodded. "That’s perfect. Today, I also have something to say."

Jiang Yutang looked at Madam Xie and calmly stated, "Mother, previously, because you were unwell, you asked me to temporarily manage the household. Now that you have recovered, I will return the responsibility. From now on, I will no longer involve myself in any matters of the mansion, big or small."

As soon as these words were spoken, the hall fell silent. The women exchanged glances. What had Jiang Yutang said?

She was giving up her position as the mistress of the household?

How was that possible?

Jiang Yutang’s only significance in Xie Yihe’s eyes was that she managed the household for him.

If Jiang Yutang no longer managed the Duke’s mansion, then in Xie Yihe’s heart, she would be completely nonexistent.

Madam Xie was taken aback.

She knew the drawbacks of managing the household all too well and quickly suppressed her emotions, forcing a smile. "A Tang, Yihe often praises you in front of me for managing the household so well. If you suddenly abandon your responsibilities, I’m afraid he will be displeased."

Jiang Yutang almost laughed at the absurdity.

"Really?"

Madam Xie felt a pang of guilt and lightly coughed.

"My health hasn’t fully recovered yet. Besides, everyone has been quite satisfied with your management over these past three years. It’s still best if you continue."

There was a hint of sarcasm in Jiang Yutang’s eyes.

Everyone was satisfied because she had been subsidizing the household with her own money, wasn’t that right?

The Old Madam and the second branch were still reasonable.

The main expenses were from their first branch. The Old Master’s social obligations, Madam Xie’s endless tonics, Xie Chaoyu’s gold and silver jewelry, and her good-for-nothing younger uncle who loved gambling and womanizing.

Over the past three years, the Duke’s mansion had spent a total of over 100,000 taels.

If it weren’t for Jiang Yutang’s monthly income, how could they have supported this?

In the past, she had deeply loved Xie Yihe and considered this power and status as her pride and reliance, devoting herself selflessly to this large family. But now...

She planned to seek a divorce and would no longer be the fool who suffered in silence!

"Mother, if your health is not good, there are plenty of others who are in good health."

Jiang Yutang’s mind was made up, her eyes cold with indifference.

"You just praised Yun Qianqian for being clever and quick to learn. Since she will enter the family sooner or later, and she has already won your favor, I don’t think she will have trouble learning such a simple task. If that doesn’t work out..."

She paused and looked at Xie Chaoyu.

"There’s also Sister Yu. She pays such close attention to the mansion’s affairs and is so perceptive. I’m sure she will do a better job than me."

Madam Xie’s face darkened. "A mansion this large cannot simply change managers. Besides, Sister Yu has never handled such matters before."

"Every mistress of a noble family has gone through this."

Jiang Yutang replied methodically.

Then, she pushed back her chair and stood up.

"That settles it. I’ll have someone send the account books over later."

Jiang Yutang ignored Madam Xie’s anger and looked at Chun Tao, instructing her, "Take this osmanthus cake back to Meng Yuan. If anyone else wants to eat it, they can buy their own."

Even a clay figure has some pride.

Her things, even if it was just a plate of cakes, others had no right to touch.

chapters.title: Return My Dowry Along with Everything Else
chapters.content:
"You! Cough, cough, cough…"

Madame Xie was so infuriated by Jiang Yutang's words that her usually healthy body suddenly faltered. Her face flushed red as she clutched her chest, unable to stop her violent coughing. The harsh sound echoed through the dining hall, grating on everyone's ears.

But this time, Jiang Yutang did not rush forward as she usually did to help her mother-in-law expectorate and attend to her.

"Jiang Yutang, is this how a daughter-in-law should behave? Look at you; you’ve angered Mother into this state!"

Xie Chaoyu, upon seeing this, was furious. She stood abruptly from her seat, eyes wide with rage as she glared at Jiang Yutang and shouted.

"Under heaven, which man doesn’t have three or four concubines? My elder brother likes Yun Qianqian; so what if he doesn’t fancy you? Your natal family is all in the borderlands. Here in the capital, you’re all alone. Who are you putting on airs for? Let me make this clear to you: no one in the Duke’s mansion will tolerate your nonsense."

Though the Second Madame didn’t know the intricacies of managing the household, she understood Xie Chaoyu’s implication. She looked at Jiang Yutang with concern.

Yes, Jiang Yutang had no natal family to rely on in the capital. No one would stand up for her grievances.

Apart from clinging to her husband and pleasing her mother-in-law, she had no other choices.

How tragic for a woman to be reduced to this.

Jiang Yutang had been about to leave with Chun Tao when she heard these words and suddenly stopped in her tracks.

She slowly turned around and looked at Xie Chaoyu, whose eyes were wide with anger. Her gaze fell on the exquisite and luxurious silk clothes and jewelry adorning Xie Chaoyu; all of which came from famous capital merchants.

Meanwhile, Jiang Yutang herself wore old clothes daily, yet she had unhesitatingly purchased these extravagant items for Xie Chaoyu.

Jiang Yutang’s expression was cold as she spoke to Xie Chaoyu in an icy tone, "Take off the clothes and jewelry you’re wearing first, then come at me with your temper."

Xie Chaoyu instantly felt the gazes of the crowd around her. A surge of blood rushed to her head, and her face turned crimson, as if it might bleed the next second.

"Who wants your shabby trinkets? Do you really think I can’t dress or wear jewelry without you? I’ll take them all off and return them to you right now!"

"Good."

Jiang Yutang agreed without hesitation. Then she turned to Madame Xie. "Since no one wants my things, Mother, you can return the dowry you’ve been keeping for me as well."

Years ago, the Jiang family had prepared a rich dowry for Jiang Yutang, filled with gold, silver, jewelry, antiques, and calligraphy and paintings.

All these valuables had been locked away in Madame Xie’s private vault under the pretense of safekeeping.

Upon hearing this, Madame Xie’s coughing fit worsened, and her body began to tremble.

Jiang Yutang scanned the crowd, seeing their varied expressions; some surprised, some embarrassed, some watching the drama unfold.

She said no more, turned, and strode out of the dining hall with Chun Tao, stepping onto the long corridor.

Chun Tao, holding the osmanthus cake, followed nervously behind Jiang Yutang.

"Madam, it’s good that we’re no longer managing the household, but isn’t this way of doing things going to greatly offend Madame and the Third Young Lady?"

Sunlight streamed through the carved lattice windows of the corridor, casting dappled shadows. In the pond, the water rippled, and lotus flowers bloomed freely. Yet Jiang Yutang had no mind to appreciate the beauty.

She looked at everything before her, the corners of her lips lifting slightly into a mocking smile. "In the past, I didn’t offend them; I even went out of my way to fawn over them. But what was the result? Didn’t they still make our lives miserable?"

In this Duke’s mansion, she, the married-in daughter-in-law, would always be an outsider.

Chun Tao, hearing this, was momentarily speechless, unable to refute.

Jiang Yutang walked through the corridor and returned to the Dream Garden. Immediately, she had the pre-prepared ledgers, account books, and the keys to the storage rooms sent to Madame Xie’s courtyard.

Then, she and Chun Tao left to register at the Imperial Medical Bureau.

Madame Xie naturally couldn’t hand over the management of the household to Yun Qianqian, an unmarried woman, especially since Yun Qianqian came from an ordinary background and had no money to contribute to the household expenses.

Left with no choice, Madame Xie had to force herself to take up the reins again, pulling Xie Chaoyu along to handle the transition, thinking that her daughter would have to learn these things eventually.

"Mother, are you really going to return all of Jiang Yutang’s dowry?" Xie Chaoyu sat in front of the ledgers, and thinking of the dazzling treasures in the storage room, she couldn’t help but wince as she looked at Madame Xie.

After returning, she had intended to defiantly return all the clothes and jewelry Jiang Yutang had bought for her. But upon checking, she realized that most of her decent belongings were purchased by Jiang Yutang.

If she really returned them all, she would have almost nothing left, so she had second thoughts.

Madame Xie, hearing this, lifted her head from the table and let out a cold laugh. "Return them? Jiang Yutang wishes! Those things; I’m keeping them to add to your dowry in the future."

Xie Chaoyu’s face lit up with joy. She hastily hugged Madame Xie’s arm and cooed, "Mother is still the best to me. But if Elder Brother finds out, he might not allow it..."

A cunning glint flashed in Madame Xie’s eyes. "Don’t worry about that. I have my own plans. Focus on the accounts for now."

Xie Chaoyu’s face fell instantly. She was filled with resentment toward Jiang Yutang for suddenly stepping down and refusing to spend money to support the household, forcing her to toil here as well.

She was an orphan with no one to dote on her. With so much money in her hands, if she didn’t spend it on the Duke’s mansion, where else could she spend it?

It was utterly infuriating.

Madame Xie hadn’t managed the household in a long time. Now that she was suddenly back in charge, it was inevitable that some oversights would occur.

As a result, when Xie Yihe returned from court, he found the main house cold, and the servants were scrambling to light the floor heating. The clothes that were supposed to be sent for washing were still untouched in the wardrobes.

How had Jiang Yutang managed the household?

Xie Yihe couldn’t help but feel a surge of anger. He called Chu Ge and ordered, "Go and invite the Young Madam here."

He felt it was necessary to have a serious talk with Jiang Yutang.

Chu Ge was somewhat confused. He disliked any tasks involving Jiang Yutang, but he still accepted the order.

After some inquiries, he learned that Jiang Yutang had already resigned from her position as the household manager.

Chu Ge was stunned.

Had Xie Yihe ordered this?

Otherwise, with Jiang Yutang’s nature, how could she possibly give it up without a second thought?

Chu Ge then went to investigate Jiang Yutang’s whereabouts.

Inside the main house of the Dream Garden, it was as silent as a winter cicada.

"Where is she?"

Xie Yihe had waited for a long time, but only Chu Ge returned to report, which displeased him.

Chu Ge reported truthfully, "Young Master, the Young Madam has gone to the Imperial Medical Bureau to register for the medical examination."

Xie Yihe’s eyebrows twitched slightly.

"She knows medicine?"

"I’ve never heard that the Young Madam has studied medicine."

Chu Ge paused, then speculated, "Perhaps the Young Madam was displeased by yesterday’s events and intentionally looked into Miss Yun’s movements. Upon learning that Miss Yun was going to register, she decided to compete with Miss Yun out of jealousy..."

Miss Yun was registering because she knew medicine. Jiang Yutang, who had barely even flipped through a medical book, was actually going to make a scene out of jealousy. It was truly embarrassing.

Chu Ge asked meaningfully, "Young Master, should I contact the Imperial Medical Bureau to have the Young Madam return?"

Xie Yihe impatiently stood up and walked out.

"I’m busy. Handle it yourself. Just one condition: absolutely do not let her harm Qianqian."

---

chapters.title: Embarrassed? She No Longer Cares
chapters.content:
Chu Ge, having received his orders, immediately knew what to do and sprang into action.

Meanwhile, on Jiang Yutang’s side:

She and Chun Tao had successfully registered at the Imperial Medical Bureau.

Not only that, but they had also encountered an old acquaintance there.

After inquiring about the situation at the Imperial Medical Bureau, Jiang Yutang learned that she had arrived on the last day of registration, and the examination would take place the next day.

The day when the Emperor’s poisoning would flare up was drawing near.

Jiang Yutang knew she could only succeed, not fail.

Her mood was tense. After returning to the Dream Garden, she immediately began reviewing her medical books, reinforcing and deepening her knowledge.

Jiang Yutang was completely absorbed, and Chun Tao didn’t dare disturb her, moving about as quietly as possible.

Time passed in this fulfilling manner. Before she knew it, the next day had arrived.

Both mistress and servant woke up early.

"Madam, I’ve already asked for leave from the Duchess on your behalf. You won’t need to attend to her for the next couple of days..." Chun Tao had just returned from Madame Xie’s courtyard, having prepared herself for a difficult refusal.

To her surprise, Madame Xie had agreed readily.

Jiang Yutang was not surprised by this.

Madame Xie had been forced to resume managing the household and was currently resentful of her. Plus, with her unwillingness to return the dowry, it was natural that she would avoid Jiang Yutang as much as possible.

Just before leaving the Dream Garden, Chun Tao glanced back at the main house, her emotions complex.

By giving up the management of the household, the Young Madam had cut off her own retreat in the Duke’s mansion.

Yet the Young Master still remained indifferent...

His heart was truly impossible to warm.

Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao left the Duke’s mansion discreetly through a side gate.

The Imperial Medical Bureau stood in a prominent corner outside the imperial palace, located in a bustling area of the capital. Its grand entrance, with its vermilion gates adorned with golden nails, stood open, and a steady stream of young examinees passed through, creating a lively atmosphere.

Jiang Yutang, with Chun Tao, followed the crowd into the Imperial Medical Bureau.

Suddenly, a commotion arose from the street outside. A dark red horse pulled a luxurious carriage made of fine ebony wood, stopping steadily in front of the Imperial Medical Bureau.

Several judges hurried forward to greet them.

"Director Xie, why have you come in person?"

At the sound of this, Jiang Yutang’s body stiffened. Her gaze, along with that of the other examinees, was drawn to that exquisite, peerless face.

Xie Yihe, dressed in a dark robe, was the first to alight from the carriage.

At this hour, shouldn’t Xie Yihe be attending morning court?

Chun Tao’s eyes widened in shock.

Young Master?!

Had he come here out of concern for the Young Madam, to smooth the way for her?

This thought had barely formed when, before Chun Tao could feel any joy, the next moment...

Not far away, Xie Yihe stood below the carriage, extending his hand toward someone inside.

Yun Qianqian lifted the carriage curtain and emerged, placing her hand in his. He helped her down.

Perhaps because they were the center of attention, with so many eyes on them, Yun Qianqian seemed a little embarrassed. Her cheeks were flushed, and her gaze was shy, like a timid little rabbit, following closely behind Xie Yihe.

The judges fawned over them as they escorted the pair inside.

The examinees instinctively stepped aside, forming a path for them. Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao were squeezed into the crowd.

Only then did Chun Tao remember that Yun Qianqian was also there to take the examination.

The Young Master had come to see her off...

Not for their Young Madam.

Chun Tao suddenly felt a pang of gratitude that she hadn’t voiced the foolish thought in her heart. Otherwise, the contrast would have made their Young Madam seem even more pitiful.

The examinees around them began whispering to their companions.

"Is that Director Xie, the rumored Grand Marshal, the Young Master of the Duke’s mansion? He’s so handsome. He’s so busy, yet he personally came to send his woman to the Imperial Medical Bureau for the examination..."

"Indeed, if a man has you in his heart, no matter how busy he is, he’ll make time for you."

"So the woman beside Director Xie must be the Young Master’s wife? She’s so beautiful, and her demeanor is excellent. They’re truly a perfect match. I’m so envious of the Young Master’s wife..."

"..."

Even though the path cleared for them was wide, the judges still found it insufficient. They scolded the nearby examinees.

"Make way! Don’t bump into the nobles!"

The examinees retreated one by one. Jiang Yutang, the true Young Madam, was jostled until her back was pressed against the wall. She and the other examinees were packed so tightly that the air barely circulated.

Jiang Yutang, at the very back, had her foreside hair slightly disheveled. Yet she had to watch as the beloved couple in the center passed by.

At that moment, as if sensing something, Yun Qianqian turned her head and looked in their direction.

Her gaze passed through the crowd in front of her, landing on Jiang Yutang, who was flushed and disheveled from the pushing. Finding it somewhat amusing, Yun Qianqian’s lips curled into a mocking smile.

Yun Qianqian and Xie Yihe’s figures disappeared from everyone’s sight.

The crowd slowly dispersed, and the scene returned to normal.

The stark contrast in their situations surged around Chun Tao’s heart like a tide. She suppressed her sense of loss, not letting a hint of emotion show on her face. She pretended as if nothing had happened and adjusted Jiang Yutang’s hair.

Jiang Yutang also did not mention the glaring scene from just now.

The two of them silently made their way toward the examination hall.

The Imperial Medical Bureau was spacious inside, with sweeping eaves, intricate brackets, towering ancient trees, and a faint aroma of herbs wafting through the air. Outside the second gate of the examination hall, Yun Qianqian was about to enter when she reached for her waist and suddenly froze.

"Oh no, Brother Yihe!"

Yun Qianqian turned around embarrassedly and looked at Xie Yihe. In a soft voice, she said, "I... I forgot to bring my examinee card. We might have to go back to the mansion..."

Xie Yihe replied indifferently, "It’s fine. I’ll just say a word to them."

For him, it was only a matter of a few words.

Yun Qianqian entered smoothly.

Soon after, Jiang Yutang arrived.

She held her examinee card and lined up. After much waiting, it was finally her turn. But during the verification, a problem arose.

Jiang Yutang was stopped at the second gate of the examination hall by a medical official.

"Jiang Yutang, is it? Your name isn’t on this registration list. You can’t go in."

How was this possible?

Jiang Yutang’s delicate eyebrows furrowed slightly. "I registered just yesterday. Please check again."

"I said it’s not there, so it’s not there. If you don’t believe me, look for yourself." The medical official’s attitude was arrogant. With a slap, he threw the ledger onto the table.

This concerned her own plans, so Jiang Yutang couldn’t afford to think of anything else. She quickly flipped through the pages, but indeed, her name was not there.

Jiang Yutang was certain.

She had definitely registered yesterday!

But now her name had suddenly disappeared. Had someone tampered with it in secret?

And who could give such an order to the Imperial Medical Bureau...

Jiang Yutang’s heart had the answer. Her fingers under her sleeve clenched into a fist.

"Have you finished looking? Are you sure? Then get out of here and go back where you came from. Don’t block the way and delay the other examinees!"

The medical official shoved Jiang Yutang roughly aside, pulling her to the side.

The long line of examinees continued to enter, each one looking curiously at Jiang Yutang, who had been singled out.

Xie Yihe, having seen Yun Qianqian off, emerged and saw this extremely embarrassing scene.

His cold, deep gaze lingered on Jiang Yutang’s humiliated face for a moment before moving away as if she were a stranger. Surrounded by the judges, he passed by her and walked out.

Jiang Yutang had no intention of giving up just like that.

She stood in place, thinking of a countermeasure. The examinee card in her hand was issued by the Imperial Medical Bureau; this was something they couldn’t deny...

"Yutang?"

At that moment, a clear male voice suddenly interrupted Jiang Yutang’s thoughts.

chapters.title: Xie Yihe Notices She No Longer Cares for Him
chapters.content:
Jiang Yutang turned her head and saw an old acquaintance; Jiang Huian!

"What are you doing standing here like an idiot instead of going in for the exam?"

Jiang Huian wore a crimson brocade robe, his dark hair tied high, his handsome face showing confusion. Then, he realized something was wrong. The smile on his thin lips froze as he turned to the physician. "What's going on?"

"Lord Jiang..." the physician stammered in shock.

He hadn't expected Jiang Yutang to know the fifth-rank Director of the Imperial Medical Bureau, Jiang Huian.

Jiang Huian and Jiang Yutang had been childhood friends, growing up together. After Jiang Yutang married, their relationship gradually grew distant. They had only reunited the day before when Jiang Yutang came to register.

The physician, sensing trouble, hardened his resolve and answered, "This young lady's name is not on the registration list. According to the rules, she cannot be allowed to enter..."

"Yesterday, I personally registered her. If her name isn't there, isn't that your mistake?" Jiang Huian frowned, quickly grasping the crux of the matter.

He turned to Jiang Yutang. "You go in for the exam first. I'll handle this."

"Thank you." Jiang Yutang nodded gratefully.

Jiang Huian looked at Jiang Yutang's delicate face, still as beautiful as before, but missing the vivid, radiant smile he remembered...

He recalled seeing Xie Yihe escorting another woman earlier, completely ignoring Jiang Yutang. His chest tightened, a bitter taste rising in his throat.

"If you really want to thank me, then win first place. Come on, Yutang, do your best and pass the exam!" Jiang Huian's eyes gleamed as he smiled with youthful vigor.

The Imperial Medical Bureau was full of sycophants and flatterers. It needed someone with real skill like Jiang Yutang.

"Okay." Jiang Yutang felt encouraged and silently cheered herself on.

The physician didn’t dare block her any longer.

Jiang Yutang finally entered the examination hall.

Inside, the invigilators were stunned when they saw Jiang Yutang enter, their eyes widening in shock.

Hadn’t they already erased her name from the list?

How did she get in?

Someone above had ordered that Jiang Yutang was not allowed to stay in the Imperial Medical Bureau, let alone appear in front of Miss Yun...

This was a disaster.

They hadn’t left any backup plan. Now, it was too late to prepare!

But...

They had heard that Jiang Yutang was just a shallow, jealous woman from a wealthy family who knew nothing about medicine. She probably wouldn’t pass the exam!

At this thought, the invigilators finally felt a little at ease.

How could Jiang Yutang not tolerate Miss Yun? It was bad enough that she schemed in the inner quarters, but now she had even followed Miss Yun to the Imperial Medical Bureau to compete with her...

No wonder Lord Xie treated her so coldly.

Who wouldn’t be embarrassed to have such a wife?

The Imperial Medical Bureau's exam had two parts: a written test on theory and a practical diagnosis test.

Today’s first test was the written exam.

As the candidates arrived and filled the large examination hall, the invigilators began distributing the test papers. The topic was on the differentiation and treatment of stroke from The Treatise on Cold Damage.

Jiang Yutang looked at the question, and familiar memories surfaced. She picked up her brush and began to think carefully about how to answer.

The air was silent, except for the rustling of the wind outside.

The invigilators, afraid Jiang Yutang might cheat, kept their attention on her, pacing back and forth. But to their shock, they discovered…

Jiang Yutang's test paper was completely blank! She hadn’t written a single word!

They froze.

All the other candidates had already written half a page...

So Jiang Yutang really hadn’t started yet.

That made sense.

Someone who had never studied medicine wouldn’t be able to write anything, even if they tried to make something up.

They had thought Jiang Yutang, this ignorant fool, would at least scribble a few words. They hadn’t expected her to be exposed so quickly.

Rotten mud was still rotten mud. How could she compare to Miss Yun?

Looking at Yun Qianqian’s paper, it was already nearly full of elegant writing.

The invigilators shook their heads.

Jiang Yutang only began writing after she had figured out her answer.

Time passed quietly.

The candidates finished one by one and left.

The number of people in the examination hall dwindled. Yun Qianqian had also left, leaving only a few scattered candidates. The invigilators watched Jiang Yutang writing swiftly, their eyes filling with even more disdain, growing bolder.

"The entry requirements for the Imperial Medical Bureau are really getting lower and lower. As long as you have connections, even any old Tom, Dick, or Harry can get in..."

"Isn’t that the truth? Some empty-headed, unlearned people are already inside. Who knows what kind of ridiculous answers they’ll write? They’d be better off handing in their papers and leaving early."

"Some people have long since lost their self-respect and shame. How could they possibly care about these things?"

"..."

Their words were clearly directed at someone. Their gazes fell on Jiang Yutang again, almost as if they were telling the remaining candidates in the hall that the person they were talking about was Jiang Yutang.

The other candidates frowned and looked over.

Jiang Yutang’s brush suddenly stopped. She lifted her head and looked at them.

The invigilator wasn’t afraid. "Candidate, what’s the matter? Don’t tell me you’re taking our words personally..."

"Is this a place for you to chat idly?" Jiang Yutang’s gaze was cold. "You’re wagging your tongues and disturbing us. That’s wrong."

So she was saying they were disturbing her, Jiang Yutang?

How ridiculous.

Had Jiang Yutang read a few medical books and now dared to speak so boldly here?

Who knew what nonsense she was scribbling on her paper?

The invigilator’s eyes were full of contempt. He was about to continue his sarcasm when another candidate protested in dissatisfaction.

"You’re disturbing my train of thought..."

"Yeah, are you going to let us take the exam or not?"

"..."

The two invigilators’ faces turned extremely ugly. They could only suppress their anger and shut their mouths.

They really wanted to see what kind of nonsense Jiang Yutang would hand in.

The invigilators all stared intently at Jiang Yutang.

Finally!

Jiang Yutang finished her answers.

She stood up abruptly, took her test paper, and walked forward, placing it on the table in front of them. She said to the invigilator, "You were right about one thing earlier. Indeed, all sorts of people can get into the Imperial Medical Bureau..."

Jiang Yutang’s sharp and clean gaze carried a hint of mockery, as if mocking their shallow and superficial judgments. The invigilator was immediately annoyed.

"You…"

Suddenly, the person next to him tugged his arm. "Look at what she wrote first."

"What? Did she scribble some nonsense, or did she write curses against us on it?"

The invigilator turned his head and looked at Jiang Yutang’s test paper. When he saw the contents clearly, he froze on the spot.

Both of them stood there like wooden chickens, their eyes filled with disbelief.

Had Jiang Yutang really written this?

The differentiation on the paper was incisive, hitting the nail on the head with every word. The treatment methods proposed were refreshingly novel, dazzling and impressive.

Without a doubt, it was the best among all the candidates.

In fact...

It even surpassed Miss Yun’s.

---

chapters.title: She Smiled So Happily at Another Man
chapters.content:
So Jiang Yutang was not an ignorant fool; she actually knew medicine!

And she had absolutely no chance to cheat, since they had been watching her the entire time in the examination hall.

They had truly underestimated Jiang Yutang.

At this moment, the invigilators’ faces burned as if they had been slapped.

Jiang Yutang’s differentiation and treatment were outstanding, her experience mature, and her medical foundation was solid; something they couldn’t compare to.

But...

It was one thing for outsiders to not know Jiang Yutang’s medical skills.

Why didn’t the person in charge know about this either?

The two invigilators were confused. After much thought, they decided to report the matter first...

...

As dusk fell, the sky was painted with splendid evening clouds, casting a glow over the Imperial Medical Bureau.

Jiang Yutang exited the examination hall and saw two familiar figures across the street; Chun Tao and Jiang Huian.

"Young Madam, are you done?" Chun Tao spotted her and immediately ran over joyfully.

Jiang Huian’s bored dark eyes lit up as well. A playful, cynical smile curved his thin lips as he quickly approached Jiang Yutang.

"Yutang, how was the exam?"

Jiang Yutang thought seriously for a moment. "It was alright."

"Oh? Rare to see our Miss Jiang being so modest," Jiang Huian crossed his arms, examining her with curiosity.

Then he teased, "You say that, but don’t actually embarrass me. I’m counting on you to join the Imperial Medical Bureau and make me look good. You have no idea how annoying it is to deal with those old foxes who only know how to speak in official jargon all day..."

As the highest-ranking official in the Imperial Medical Bureau, Jiang Huian didn’t need her to make him look good. Jiang Yutang knew he was joking.

But his familiar tone instantly lightened her mood.

"I can’t help you with your troubles."

"Who says you can’t? If you come, you can be annoyed with me. At least I’ll have company. And if worst comes to worst..." Jiang Huian raised an eyebrow, smirking mischievously, "Bring out that ‘demon king’ energy you had as a kid; climbing roofs and starting fights. I guarantee they’ll all back off three steps and never dare to play those twisted games again."

Jiang Yutang had been sent to Mount Mei precisely because of that behavior as a child.

She couldn’t help but laugh, exasperated.

The woman’s red lips curved upward, her clear eyes bright, faintly revealing the charm of her youth.

"Exactly. You should smile more often. Don’t always keep a straight face like an old scholar."

Jiang Huian gazed at Jiang Yutang’s smiling face, his voice gentle. "No matter how unhappy we feel inside, we shouldn’t let others see it."

He didn’t know exactly what had happened to Jiang Yutang after her marriage, but seeing Xie Yihe’s extremely cold attitude, Jiang Huian could easily guess that her life in the Duke of An’s mansion was not going well...

Xie Yihe had only gained one more person by marrying Jiang Yutang, but Jiang Yutang, by marrying him, had gained an entire group of strangers as family.

A strange environment, strange family; she had to integrate, adapt to their lifestyle, their tastes in food.

With no support from her husband and no backing from her natal family, she had to face countless battles and trivial frustrations alone. The bitterness of it all was something an outsider like him could never fully understand.

But adults had to maintain their dignity.

Even if Jiang Huian understood, he wouldn’t expose it and hurt the pride Jiang Yutang was carefully maintaining.

He said, "Don’t worry. Given our friendship, I’ll protect you in the Imperial Medical Bureau."

Their eyes met, and Jiang Yutang felt a surge of emotion. She continued talking with Jiang Huian.

Outside the gates of the Imperial Medical Bureau, the street was quiet. A carriage was parked still, and the person inside had taken in the warm, heartwarming scene.

Xie Yihe’s eyes darkened. He expressionlessly averted his gaze.

He asked Chu Ge inside the carriage, "Where is Miss Yun?"

Chu Ge gave an awkward reply, "Lord Heir, it seems we arrived late. Miss Yun has already left. Also..."

He hesitated, making Xie Yihe feel irritated.

"Speak."

"Earlier, the censor sent a message saying that the Young Madam..."

Chu Ge was reluctant, but he didn’t dare deceive Xie Yihe. He bluntly said, "She passed the written exam of the Imperial Medical Bureau and even won first place. Her test paper amazed many physicians; it surpassed Miss Yun’s work!"

Chu Ge had wanted to prevent Jiang Yutang from harming Yun Qianqian, so he had ordered someone to erase her registration, stripping Jiang Yutang of her qualification to take the exam. Who would have thought...

Jiang Yutang actually knew Jiang Huian and had passed the exam smoothly.

Xie Yihe’s expression changed instantly upon hearing this.

His narrow eyes were inscrutable. He couldn’t help but look again at the woman not far from the carriage window.

Xie Yihe’s carriage, parked prominently on the street, was hard to miss.

At the entrance of the Imperial Medical Bureau, Jiang Huian had just seen Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao out when his peripheral vision caught Xie Yihe. He subtly furrowed his brows.

Was Xie Yihe here to pick up that woman named Yun again?

And the Jiang Yutang in front of him seemed to have already accepted all this. She wouldn’t be so self-deluded as to think Xie Yihe was here to pick her up.

Jiang Yutang also noticed Xie Yihe, but after a glance, she looked away.

She stopped walking and said to Jiang Huian, "It’s getting late. Chun Tao and I will head back now."

Jiang Huian’s heart ached. He wanted to stand up for Jiang Yutang as he had in their childhood; galloping through the streets, recklessly escorting her home, and telling everyone that their Yutang wasn’t someone to be bullied.

The separation of men and women in Beiming wasn’t strict, but Jiang Yutang was already married. If he did that, it would only cause unnecessary trouble for her.

He could only say, "Alright. Be careful on your way. See you tomorrow."

The two parted ways.

Twilight deepened, and the long street grew quiet. The vendors had packed up their stalls, and pedestrians walked in twos and threes.

Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao headed toward the Duke of An’s mansion.

At that moment, Chu Ge stepped forward to block their path.

"Young Madam, the Lord Heir invites you to the carriage."

Jiang Yutang saw no need. "If there’s something, just say it."

Chu Ge felt Jiang Yutang was being ungrateful. Normally, she was always trying to get close to the Lord Heir. Now that the Lord Heir was willing to see her, she was putting on airs.

"This is the Lord Heir’s order." Chu Ge was impatient. After delivering the message, he turned and walked away.

He had done his duty.

The Lord Heir couldn’t blame him.

Chun Tao was furious. What kind of person was this?

Jiang Yutang pressed her lips together, hesitated for a moment, then turned back and boarded Xie Yihe’s carriage.

Inside the exquisitely decorated carriage, there was a faint scent of jasmine; the signature fragrance of Yun Qianqian.

Xie Yihe sat opposite her, his obsidian-like narrow eyes fixed tightly on Jiang Yutang’s calm face.

"What were you and Jiang Huian talking about just now? You were smiling so happily."

chapters.title: Past and Present Lives, Utterly Meaningless
chapters.content:
Jiang Yutang did not answer. Instead, she looked up and asked, "Why did you send someone to erase my name?"

Xie Yihe paused at her words and let out a cold scoff.

"You still have the nerve to ask?"

He continued, "The entire mansion is in chaos, and even my court robes have gone missing. As the steward of the An Guo Duke's mansion, you neglect your duties and instead go to the Imperial Physician's Institute to make a fool of yourself. Yutang, tell me yourself, is this appropriate?"

The air inside the carriage was stifling, mixed with that sweet fragrance, making Jiang Yutang feel suffocated.

Currently, the one managing the household was Madame Xie.

Xie Yihe had blamed the wrong person.

"Regarding the household management, you should verify the facts clearly before holding me accountable. Moreover, you can rest assured; I went to the Imperial Physician's Institute not for Yun Qianqian, but simply to find something to do. Aren't you annoyed by me following you around every day?"

Jiang Yutang had merely stopped following him around the mansion, yet she could still run into him outside!

Xie Yihe's narrow eyes turned cold. "It was never my idea for you to manage the household in the first place."

On the contrary, he had opposed it.

"You insisted on managing the household, so do it properly. Don't act so indecisively; it makes you look rather unsightly. Also, stop going to the Imperial Physician's Institute."

Jiang Yutang felt a wave of helplessness and refused, "Barring any accidents, I passed the written examination. I intend to continue with the next stages."

But as soon as she finished speaking, Xie Yihe's expression suddenly turned mocking.

Jiang Yutang sensed something was wrong. "What do you mean by that?"

"You and Jiang Huian may be on good terms, but that doesn't mean he should abuse his authority to leak exam questions and help you cheat your way through the Imperial Physician's Institute's written test."

Xie Yihe's face was cold. "This is unfair to Qianqian and the other candidates."

Such an outstanding exam paper; even the imperial physicians couldn't have written it. How could Jiang Yutang, a complete outsider to medicine, have produced it?

He didn’t believe it for a second.

Jiang Yutang's pupils trembled, her eyes filled with disbelief.

"I didn't."

Xie Yihe met her gaze, hesitated for a moment, then indifferently hummed in acknowledgment.

She could say whatever she wanted.

He had already ordered someone to suppress her results.

The top candidate would only be Yun Qianqian.

The atmosphere suddenly froze.

Jiang Yutang just stared at him blankly.

Her gaze was too pained for Xie Yihe to ignore as he had before. Moreover, she had indeed been acting strangely lately...

Xie Yihe remained silent for a moment. "Having connections is a good thing. I don’t blame you for it."

Jiang Yutang looked at the face she had once deeply loved and suddenly found it amusing.

Even though she was so close to him, it felt as if they were separated by an endless ocean.

He didn’t need her explanations, nor did he want to hear them.

Jiang Yutang recalled that in both her past and present lives, she had countless times defended herself before Xie Yihe, but to him, it had all been nothing more than meaningless nonsense.

Utterly meaningless.

Jiang Yutang suddenly lost all motivation. She lightly acknowledged him, turned her head away, and indifferently looked out the carriage window.

Outside, the sky was in that twilight state, tinged with a beautiful peacock blue. The carriage was dimly lit.

Seeing that Jiang Yutang had finally come to her senses, Xie Yihe said no more.

The carriage smoothly returned to the An Guo Duke's mansion, and the two parted ways; one heading to the Pear Blossom Courtyard, the other returning to the Dream Garden.

Jiang Yutang walked toward the Dream Garden.

On the mansion's path, Chun Tao followed closely behind, cautiously observing Jiang Yutang's expression. Her mood was a mix of confusion and worry, wanting to ask but not knowing how to begin.

Jiang Yutang noticed. "What's wrong?"

A hint of struggle flashed in Chun Tao's eyes. After a moment of hesitation, she asked, "Young Mistress, could it be that Young Master has misunderstood your relationship with Director Jiang..."

She had been walking beside the carriage earlier and didn’t know what had happened inside.

Jiang Yutang couldn’t help but laugh.

"No."

How could Xie Yihe possibly be jealous over her?

Chun Tao secretly let out a sigh of relief, but then felt something was still off. She had once heard the wet nurses in the mansion say that only when one’s heart was set on someone would they feel jealousy. So Young Master’s reaction was...

She fell silent.

The mistress and servant returned to the Dream Garden. The courtyard was no longer as clean and orderly as before. The main house was unlit, the peeling windows remained broken, and the maids and servants were either slacking off or hiding in corners, gossiping idly.

Dinner had not even been prepared yet.

No wonder Xie Yihe was displeased.

These maids and servants, though part of the Duke's household, still needed discipline.

Such negligence had never occurred when Jiang Yutang was in charge.

"Come in with me."

Jiang Yutang's gaze swept over the guilty servants before she spoke to Zhi Lan, the first-class maid of the Dream Garden.

Zhi Lan's heart sank. Reluctantly, she followed Jiang Yutang to the side room. The other maids and servants in the courtyard, seeing this, all wore knowing expressions.

What was this? They had thought Young Mistress had truly given up her authority and no longer intended to manage the Young Master or the household.

They hadn’t expected her to last less than a day before, without any backbone, ordering Zhi Lan to quickly tidy up the main house to please the Young Master before his return.

The servants didn’t believe Jiang Yutang could bear to give up her stewardship.

They firmly believed she would demand it back from Madame Xie.

However...

Half an hour later, Zhi Lan burst out of the side room, beaming with joy. Contrary to their expectations, she did not rush to clean the Young Master’s main house. Instead, she dashed into the tea room and began tinkering with something.

It seemed Young Mistress had passed on her excellent tea-brewing skills to Zhi Lan.

What in the world was going on?

Inside the side room, the candlelight flickered.

Chun Tao looked displeased. "Young Mistress, do you really bear to pass on your excellent tea-brewing skills to that girl Zhi Lan?"

Jiang Yutang, buried in a medical book and reviewing the next day's assessment topics, replied indifferently, "Zhi Lan wanted to learn. There’s nothing to be reluctant about."

She didn’t want to be disturbed by anything related to Xie Yihe anymore.

Chun Tao said no more.

The night passed uneventfully.

The next day, Jiang Yutang and Chun Tao went to the Imperial Physician's Institute again.

This time, the practical assessment involved setting up partitioned examination booths with curtains. Inside each booth sat a patient, and the candidates were to diagnose their conditions through observation, listening, questioning, and pulse-taking, then provide a diagnosis and treatment.

The finished candidates exited one by one.

Time passed quietly. Jiang Yutang waited in line, feeling anxious, her attention fully on the assessment. She didn’t even notice when Xie Yihe had arrived.

Inside, all was silent.

The supervisor bowed and approached the main door of the examination hall.

"Director Xie, have you come to pick up Miss Yun?"

Xie Yihe lightly acknowledged.

The supervisor sighed inwardly. Director Xie truly valued Miss Yun.

As the Grand Marshal of the Northern Darkness, though he didn’t have to attend court today, his hands were still full with official business. Yet he had made time to come here. Perhaps because he had missed picking up Yun Qianqian yesterday, he had come early today.

Xie Yihe was in a bad mood.

First, Jiang Yutang was still neglecting her duties, leaving the Duke's mansion in disarray.

Second...

Jiang Yutang’s exam paper, which he had suppressed, had been singled out and brought to light!

Just then, Jiang Huian, as if sensing something, turned his head and flashed a grin at Xie Yihe.

On his own turf, if anyone tried to bully Yutang, they wouldn’t even get through the door.
